last_full_coverage_good.description: Complete Stihl Decoder v1.1 release with StopHeling scan, static model cards, and complete database. Contained 13 serial ranges spanning Plants 1, 2, 3, and 8, covering chainsaws, blowers (BR 340/420, BR 600), and brushcutters (FS 120/250, FS 130). Zero fallback heuristics.

last_behaviorally_safe.description: Last behaviorally safe commit before synthetic range collapse. Array.find first-match without mass fallbacks, though 9 ranges were pruned from active JSON.

first_data_pruning.description: Pruned 9 out of 13 historical ranges from stihl_database.json (subsequently moved to seed.js in commit 90bb431).

first_critical_range_collapse.description: Synthesized 25M serial range 145000000–169999999 for MS 260 by merging BR 340/420 (145-159M) and MS 260 Laat (160-169M), absorbing 15 million blower serials.

first_mass_fallback.description: Introduced mass prefix heuristics in decoder.js: '18/17' -> MS 261, '14/15/16' -> MS 260, default fallback -> 'MS 261 C-M Gen 2', fallback category -> 'Kettingzaag'. Caused 95% of test serials to resolve to MS 260 / MS 261.

timeline_reconciliation.discrepancy_resolution: Commit 4c0de6f was the last full-coverage database state (13 ranges across all plants), while commit 45c3b49 was the last behaviorally-safe commit prior to the 40d3cb7 collapse. The apparent contradiction between 4c0de6f and 45c3b49 is resolved by recognizing 4c0de6f as LAST_FULL_COVERAGE_GOOD and 45c3b49 as LAST_BEHAVIORALLY_SAFE.

data_loss_commits.summary: Pruned 9 out of 13 historical ranges (041 AV, 026 Vroeg, MS 260 Laat, MS 500i, MS 290 family, BR 340/420, FS 130, FS 120/250) from stihl_database.json.
Omitted Plant 2 (BR 600) and Plant 8 (MS 170) from stihl_database.json when switching from serial_breakpoints to model_serial_ranges, leaving them stranded in seed.js.
Removed MS 201 ranges from model_serial_ranges to align strictly with pilot SEO pages, reducing active canonical database to only 3 ranges in Plant 1.

logic_regression_commits.summary: Unconditional fallback to MS 261 C-M or database.models[0], plus synthetic 25M range for MS 260.
Mass prefix heuristics in decoder.js: '18/17' -> MS 261, '14/15/16' -> MS 260, fallback -> 'MS 261 C-M Gen 2', fallback category -> 'Kettingzaag'. Mapped 95% of test serials to MS 260 / 261.

later_partial_remediations.summary: Removed hardcoded startsWith prefix logic and MS 261 fallback from decoder.js, but left the synthetic 25M MS 260 range in stihl_database.json.
Blocked technical specs from attaching to breakpoint records.
Added SerialChronologyResolver and modelAssist, but froze canonical database at the 3 Plant 1 ranges.

current_residual_defect.database_defect: Resolved in Recovery and R1: 8 ranges restored, isolated from synthetic collapse, calibrated to MEDIUM confidence.
current_residual_defect.engine_defect: Resolved in Recovery and R1: StihlRangeResolver exposes findMatches, multi-level resolution, and explicit evidence/semantic classes.
current_residual_defect.ui_state_defect: Resolved in Recovery: index.html clears state variables and DOM elements at start of handleDecode().
current_residual_defect.seed_drift_defect: Resolved in Recovery and R1: seed.cjs synchronized with stihl_database.json, seed.js marked deprecated.
